title: Backup scope · unavailable
expect: The unavailable selected album remains a selected removable row.
Photo count is unavailable rather than guessed; the scope never widens.
Album rows lead with 44-point rounded cover thumbnails on iPhone and Mac; a missing cover is a neutral tile.
Scroll the virtualized list and toggle a row: cover identity stays stable, off-screen requests cancel, and search, summary and checkmarks remain.

actions.result: The other three choices persist; about 4,210 photos becomes available.
